time_plan.30m: Check whether the market move is corroborated by any wire headlines (Reuters/AP/Bloomberg) or is isolated Polymarket noise; watch SPY and ES futures tick reaction.
time_plan.1h: Confirm if VIX is rising in tandem and whether volume in SPY is elevated versus average; distinguish genuine risk-off from thin-book manipulation.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether credible reporting has emerged; if none, expect mean reversion in the prediction market and fade the equity signal.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether any move persisted into a durable trend or fully reversed; check White House / official government statements.
time_plan.12h: Close the window: mark whether SPY realized a risk-off move, and log whether the prediction-market spike preceded any public confirmation.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a Trump resignation would signal acute, unexpected political instability at the top of the US executive branch. Sudden leadership uncertainty typically triggers a risk-off reaction: equities sell first as investors price policy discontinuity, succession ambiguity, and headline risk. The base rate of resignation is near zero, so most probability movement is noise; only a genuinely large, credible spike would move SPY meaningfully. Expected value is negative but modest given how unlikely a real event is, with a fat left tail if the signal is real.

time_plan.6h: Assess persistence of any safe-haven bid and cross-check with Treasury and USD moves.
time_plan.12h: Close window: record whether gold realized a safe-haven move and whether it lagged or led public confirmation.

predictions.reasoning: Acute US political instability tends to push flows into safe havens; gold is a classic beneficiary of governance/succession uncertainty and would likely catch a bid if a Trump-resignation probability spiked credibly. The mapping is weaker and slower than the equity reaction, and gold is driven more by rates and USD than by a single political headline, so confidence is low and magnitude modest. Real signal would produce a larger move; noise produces essentially nothing.

evidence_used: Market question asks about a very low base-rate tail event (a sitting US president resigning)
Resolution triggers on announcement, not actual resignation, widening the set of headline catalysts
Primary topic cabinet_government / US region implies executive-branch instability channel
General macro relationship: political leadership shocks are risk-off for equities and supportive for safe havens
uncertainty_notes: Base rate of a Trump resignation is extremely low; most probability movement is likely noise or manipulation in a thin market
The 700bps tradable threshold is unlikely to be met absent a genuine, publicly corroborated shock
Gold is dominated by rates/USD, so its exposure to this specific event is weak
Direction of USD is ambiguous in a US-specific political shock (could weaken on domestic risk or strengthen on global safe-haven flows)

llm_justification.summary: This market concerns an extremely low-probability tail event (Trump resigning/announcing resignation by end-2026). A sharp, credible spike in its implied probability would signal acute US executive-branch instability, mapping to a risk-off reaction: US equities (SPY) down and safe havens (gold) up. However, the base rate is near zero and prediction-market moves here are dominated by noise and thin liquidity, so both mappings carry low confidence and modest expected magnitude, with fat tails only if a genuine event is confirmed.
key_assumptions: A material prediction-market move reflects new information rather than thin-book noise or manipulation
Political leadership shocks transmit to markets via the standard risk-off channel
The move in the prediction market precedes broad public confirmation (the leakage hypothesis)
failure_modes: The spike is pure noise/manipulation in a thin market and no asset moves — most likely outcome
The event/rumor is already public and priced, so no incremental asset reaction occurs
Equity/gold proxies are only weakly exposed to a single US political headline and are dominated by rates, earnings, and macro flows
A resignation could paradoxically be read as reducing uncertainty in some scenarios, reversing the risk-off direction
Move reverses within hours as the prediction market re-prices back toward the ~0 base rate
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
